column1: # boru Language Specification: generic types — schemas + instantiation
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# `def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T]` declares a generic SCHEMA:
# `gen [...]` declares the type parameters (binding placeholder types
# for the constructor body and parking the spec for the next type
# constructor), `refine Record` / `fnsig` builds the body with the
# placeholders live, and `def` installs the schema. `Box of [Integer]`
# instantiates: arity-checks (defaults fill), constraint-checks each
# argument against its `extends` bound (Is-membership — lattice bounds,
# predicates, disjuncts, negations, and surfaces all answer uniformly),
# and memoises ONE instantiation per (schema, canonical args).
# Recursion uses `Self of [T]` (the schema's own name is unbound while
# its body builds). See design/legacy/GENERICS.10.ignore.
# §1  record schemas — declare + instantiate
def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T] end Box
column3: a schema NAME denotes its minted node and renders as the name (§6)

column1: def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T] end Box of [Integer]
column3: instantiation substitutes the parameter

column1: def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T] end Box of [String]
column3: …independently per argument

column1: def Pair gen [K V] refine Record [key:K value:V] end Pair of [String Integer]
column3: two parameters substitute positionally

column1: def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T] end (Box of [Integer]) teq (Box of [Integer])
column3: instantiations are memoised — one identity per (schema, args)

column1: def Stack gen [T] refine Record [items:[:T]] end Stack of [Integer]
column3: a typed-list child constraint substitutes

column1: def Wrap gen [T] refine Record [tags:{:T}] end Wrap of [String]
column3: a typed-map child constraint substitutes

def Mapper gen [T U] fnsig [[T] [U]] end (Mapper of [Integer String]) typeof

column1: # §3  bounds (extends) — Is-membership, uniformly
def Sorted gen [(T extends Number)] refine Record [items:[:T]] end Sorted of [Integer]

column1: def Sorted gen [(T extends Number)] refine Record [items:[:T]] end Sorted of [String]
column3: …and rejects a non-member loudly

column3: …and rejects a non-exposer

column1: def Pos (Integer gt 0) def H gen [(T extends Pos)] refine Record [x:T] end H of [Pos]
column3: a predicate-refinement bound admits itself; the named argument renders as the name (§6)

column1: # §4  defaults — lazy, may reference earlier parameters
def Result gen [T (E default Error)] refine Record [ok:T err:E] end Result of [Integer]
column3: a defaulted parameter fills when omitted

column3: …and is overridable

def Tree gen [T] refine Record [value:T left:(Self of [T])] end Tree of [Integer]
column3: Self ties the recursive knot to the in-flight instantiation

def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T] end Box of [Integer String]

column1: # §7  integration — typed defs, fn params, modules, shadowing
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end def b:(Box of [Integer]) {value:42} b typeof
column3: a parenthesised annotation evaluates — typed def constructs the instance

column3: …with the substituted field typing enforced

column3: an instantiation-typed fn param dispatches

column3: a bare-schema param admits any instantiation (family membership)

column3: …and rejects non-members

column3: …and rejects sibling-instantiation elements

column1: # §8  value-to-type inference — a bare schema as a construction target
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end (make Box {value:42}) typeof
column3: make infers the type argument from the body

column3: …and so does a bare-schema typed-def annotation (typeof-consistent)
